title: Delete tk cloud, tk sandbox, tk herd, tk config migrate and tk merge, and the packages only they use
description: Commands: cmd/tk/cmd/cloud*.go, sandbox.go, herd*.go, substrate_gate.go, config_migrate.go, merge.go (+tests). Packages: internal/cloud/*, cloudcredentials, sandbox, workerprompt, herd/{client,dashboard,relay,herdtest}, herdclient, worktree, ticks (legacy tk run wrapper), contracts (bundle readers). Also cmd/tk/main.go's stale printUsage and dispatch entries (channel, tell, factory, cloud run…, herd spawn…).
acceptance_criteria: [A1] of the epic; go build/vet ./... pass; 'tk --help' and printUsage list no execution verb; a test asserts the removed verbs are unknown commands.
